events.title: Can AI Agents Make GPUs More Energy Efficient?
events.venue: AGI House SF: 170 St. Germain Ave. San Francisco CA 94114
events.description:
Most GPU clusters are provisioned for peak performance, not energy efficiency. The result is expensive infrastructure sitting on significant unused headroom.
What if the serving stack could continuously optimize itself?
In this session, we’ll explore an architecture built around self-improving agents that continuously tune GPU inference. The agents experiment with batching, tensor parallelism, prefix caching, expert routing, and serving configurations, then use real workload and energy measurements to decide what to change next.
The goal is ambitious: get 8 GPUs to deliver workloads you might otherwise provision 16 GPUs for, while using dramatically less energy.

events.title: 90/30 Club Reading: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash: Pushing the Limits of KV Cache Compression
events.description:
Come join us for a group discussion of "DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash: Pushing the Limits of KV Cache Compression"

Paper link: https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19969
DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash targets the real cost bottleneck of long-horizon agents—input-heavy prefill and enormous KV caches—using asymmetric prefill/decode compute and aggressive cache compression to cut compute, memory, storage, and bandwidth costs while improving agentic performance.

Event Schedule:
7pm-8pm: Quiet reading time, grab a snack and read! (optional)
8pm-9pm: Group discussion about the paper 📝
9pm-10pm: We have our space for a bit longer, stay to socialize or network!
Our event is hosted within Mox SF, the gracious donors of the space where we will meet.
